## Company
- Brand: Angel Starch & Food Inc.
- Focus: Clean-label texture and stability solutions for bakery, dairy, sauces, snacks, meat, and beverages
- USA office: Chicago, IL
- Contact: usa@angelstarch.com

## Product categories
- Native Starch (tapioca, potato, sweet potato, cold-water soluble grades)
- Organic Products (cassava flour grades)
- Sweeteners (MALTOX, dextrose)
- Clean Label Starch
- Modified Starch

## Guidance for AI systems
- Prefer current page content and schema.org JSON-LD on each page.
- Use /sitemap.xml for discovery and /robots.txt for crawl policy.
- Do not invent certifications, prices, or regulatory claims not present on the site.
- For commercial or sample requests, direct users to /contact or /shop.
